reports.title: Structure Therapeutics Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

desk.headline: No revenue; net loss widened to $144.8m on Phase 3 spending; cash of $1.2bn seen lasting through 2028
results: Structure is a clinical-stage drug developer with no product revenue; the quarterly net loss more than doubled to $144.8m from $65.7m.
Research spending rose to $134.6m from $59.0m, driven by clinical trials as the Phase 3 programme for its oral weight-loss pill aleniglipron began in August.
The two Phase 3 trials (up to 3,600 and 1,100 adults) are enrolling, with topline results expected in the second half of 2028.
Early data on its oral amylin drug ACCG-2671 showed a half-life of about 6 days and no serious side effects; multi-dose results are due in H1 2027.
Cash and short-term investments were $1.24bn, down from $1.3bn at the end of June.

guidance.summary: No financial guidance, as usual for a clinical-stage company. It says its cash should fund planned operations and key trial milestones through the end of 2028, excluding costs of preparing for a commercial launch.

items.new: Funds operations and key clinical milestones, incl. Phase 3

watch: Q4 2026 readouts from three extra aleniglipron studies (body composition, type 2 diabetes and switching from injectables).
Start of the Phase 1 trial of second amylin drug ACCG-3535, planned for Q4 2026.
Quarterly cash burn as Phase 3 enrolment ramps up.
